// Batched interior pivot: select a nonempty independent set of pivots with
// disjoint closed neighbourhoods. Per-vertex minimum ownership guarantees
// independence and progress, but not a maximal set. The selection groups
// candidate claims by vertex, then reduces conflict flags by candidate. Its
// intermediate row count is proportional to the total neighbourhood claims;
// it never rescans a global vertex-ownership list for every candidate.

MATCH (a:Node {graph_id: $graph_id, t: 1})-[pe:Wire {t: 2}]-(b:Node {t: 1})
WHERE id(a) < id(b)
  AND a.phase IS NOT NULL AND b.phase IS NOT NULL
  AND a.phase % 2 = round(a.phase % 2)
  AND b.phase % 2 = round(b.phase % 2)
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (a)-[w:Wire]-(x:Node) WHERE w.t <> 2 OR x.t <> 1 }
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (b)-[w:Wire]-(x:Node) WHERE w.t <> 2 OR x.t <> 1 }
WITH a, b, id(pe) AS rank
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(na:Node)
WITH a, b, rank, collect(DISTINCT na) AS Na
OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(nb:Node)
WITH a, b, rank, Na, collect(DISTINCT nb) AS Nb
WITH collect({a: a, b: b, rank: rank, claim: [a, b] + Na + Nb}) AS P

UNWIND P AS p
UNWIND p.claim AS v
WITH v, collect(p) AS claimants, min(p.rank) AS owner
UNWIND claimants AS p
WITH p.a AS a, p.b AS b, p.rank AS rank,
     sum(CASE WHEN p.rank = owner THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS conflicts
WHERE conflicts = 0
WITH collect({a: a, b: b}) AS survivors

UNWIND survivors AS sv
WITH sv.a AS a, sv.b AS b
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(na:Node)
WHERE na <> b
WITH a, b, collect(DISTINCT na) AS a_nbrs
OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[:Wire {t: 2}]-(nb:Node)
WHERE nb <> a
WITH a, b, a_nbrs, collect(DISTINCT nb) AS b_nbrs
WITH a, b,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE NOT x IN b_nbrs] AS only_a,
     [x IN b_nbrs WHERE NOT x IN a_nbrs] AS only_b,
     [x IN a_nbrs WHERE x IN b_nbrs] AS shared

CALL {
  WITH only_a, only_b
  UNWIND only_a AS u
  UNWIND only_b AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  WITH u, v, collect(existing) AS existing_edges
  FOREACH (edge IN existing_edges | DELETE edge)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN size(existing_edges) = 0 THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_a, shared
  UNWIND only_a AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  WITH u, v, collect(existing) AS existing_edges
  FOREACH (edge IN existing_edges | DELETE edge)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN size(existing_edges) = 0 THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

CALL {
  WITH only_b, shared
  UNWIND only_b AS u
  UNWIND shared AS v
  OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[existing:Wire]-(v)
  WITH u, v, collect(existing) AS existing_edges
  FOREACH (edge IN existing_edges | DELETE edge)
  FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN size(existing_edges) = 0 THEN [1] ELSE [] END |
    CREATE (u)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: u.graph_id}]->(v))
}

FOREACH (n IN only_a |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + b.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN only_b |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + a.phase) % 2)
FOREACH (n IN shared |
  SET n.phase = (coalesce(n.phase, 0) + a.phase + b.phase + 1) % 2)

DETACH DELETE a, b

RETURN count(*) AS pivot_operations_performed
